energy_tooltip: Energy drops by 1 every {drain} turns. Above 0, you regain 1 HP every {regen} turns. At 0, you lose 1 HP every {starve} turns.
look_hint: Hover a tile to inspect it.
look_stairs: Once the grille is open: stand on them and press Enter.
look_exit: Stand on it and press Enter to escape.
look_locked: Closed by a grille. The pickpocket has the key: kill him, pick up the key, then step on the stairs.
look_locked_portal: Closed by a grille. The Warden carries the key of the portal.
look_barrel: Blocks the way. Walk into it to break it: {pct}% chance of finding something.
look_remains: The skeleton rises again in {turns} turns. Step on the bones to crush them.
look_tracks: The pickpocket went through here {turns} turns ago, heading {dir}.
look_thief: Roams from room to room with the key.
look_thief_tired: Out of breath: catching his wind.
look_key_carrier: Carries the key of the floor.
look_revives: Rises again from its bones if you leave them.
item_thunder_desc: Strikes every enemy within {radius} tiles for {value} damage.
item_blink_desc: Teleports you at least {value} tiles away from every enemy.
item_map_desc: Reveals the whole layout of the floor.
item_dagger_desc: Joins your daggers (F key). Falls where it hits.
item_key_desc: Opens the grille of this floor's stairs.
welcome: The dungeon has {total} floors. The exit is at the very bottom.
inventory_full: Inventory full: {name} stays on the ground.
thunder_none: No enemy within {radius} tiles: the scroll is kept.
used_map: The layout of the floor is revealed.
full_health: You are already at full health: the potion is kept.
not_hungry: You are not hungry: the ration is kept.
stairs_here: The grille is open. Press Enter to go down.
exit_here: The portal is open. Press Enter to escape.
hungry: You are getting hungry: eat a ration soon.
starving: You are starving and lose health.
key_thief: The grille of the stairs is closed. A pickpocket has the key: listen, follow his tracks.
key_warden: The portal is closed by a grille. The Warden carries its key.
keys_heard: You hear keys jingling to the {dir}.
thief_flees: The pickpocket sees you and bolts.
thief_tired: The pickpocket is out of breath.
key_dropped: The key falls to the ground.
key_picked: You pick up the key. Step on the stairs to open the grille.
key_picked_portal: You pick up the key of the portal.
grille_locked: The grille is closed. You need the pickpocket's key.
grille_locked_portal: The grille of the portal is closed. The Warden has the key.
grille_opens: The key turns: the grille rises.
grille_opens_portal: The key turns: the grille of the portal rises.
no_daggers: No daggers left: pick up the ones you threw.
barrel_empty: The barrel bursts. It was empty.
bones_fall: The bones collapse... but still stir.
keyrow_thief: Key: a pickpocket has it. Find him.
keyrow_tired: Key: the pickpocket is exhausted. Quick.
keyrow_dropped: Key: on the ground. Pick it up.
keyrow_have: Key in hand. To the stairs.
keyrow_open: Grille open. Enter to go down.
keyrow_tooltip: The pickpocket flees as soon as he sees you, but tires quickly. His keys can be heard {hear} steps away, and he leaves fresh tracks.
dagger_tooltip: Throwing daggers. F aims at the pickpocket first, otherwise the nearest enemy within {range} tiles. Right click: throw at the hovered enemy.
end_stats: Level {level}   ·   Enemies slain {kills}   ·   Keys {keys}   ·   Best momentum {elan}   ·   Turns {turns}
controls: Move: arrows / {keys}   Dash: Shift + direction   Wait: Space   Dagger: F or right click   Items: 1-6, Shift to drop   Descend: Enter   Sound: M
enemy_winds_up: {Name} winds up a heavy blow: get out of the red zone.
warden_winds_up: {Name} raises its axe: shockwave next turn.
warden_enraged: The Warden is enraged: its shockwave now reaches 2 tiles.
archer_aims: {Name} takes aim at you: leave the red line.
keg_lit: The fuse hisses: explosion in {turns} turns.
death_blast: An explosion got the better of you on floor {floor}.
look_keg: Bump it to light the fuse ({turns} turns), bump it again to send it sliding. A dagger sets it off. Blast: {damage} damage within {radius} tile, you included.
look_keg_lit: Fuse lit: explodes in {turns} turns. Bump it to send it sliding; it explodes on contact with an enemy.
look_winding_up: Winding up a heavy blow: the red zone is struck next turn.
look_aiming: Aiming at you: the arrow follows the red line next turn.
look_heavy: Sometimes winds up a heavy blow, shown in red.
look_slam: Shockwave every {every} actions, shown in red.
elan_tooltip: Every kill adds a flame (up to {max}) and heals as many HP as flames. Every {every} flames: +1 damage. Momentum fades after {window} turns without hitting.
dash_tooltip: Shift + direction: rush up to {range} tiles. The enemy in the way takes a charge (ATK +{bonus}, +1 per tile run), is pushed back and loses its next action. Recharge: {cooldown} turns.
